reason: B is better grounded by directly relevant irradiation evidence showing homogenization and no precipitation in an Hf-containing W–Ta–Cr–V alloy at 1073 K and ~8 dpa, and it proposes a decisive APT/TEM comparison. Its weakness is that the cited alloy also substantially changes the W/Cr/V ratios—not just Hf—and the chosen 7 at% Hf and bulk-fabrication benefit are unsupported, but A’s Y2O3 mechanism and processing benefit are more speculative and oxide dispersoids could themselves introduce hardening or heterogeneous nucleation sites.
